serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Lady Annalie: Hi Anon! What’s up?
You: Good, I guess…
Lady Annalie: Well, no offence, but you don't look very good. I’m mean, like, you look worse than usual.
You: …
#Annalie.Face.sad
Lady Annalie: Is everything alright? I wouldn’t want my best client to go away…
You: Sorry for being a bother, I’m alright! You don’t have to worry. 
Lady Annalie: You are not being a bother! Listen…
Lady Annalie: I’m not asking you to tell me about your problems. I’m just saying that if you are in need of someone to listen to you, I’m all ears.
